title: Set the benchmark arm of the Chat planner
description: Development only, for a benchmark of the Chat the person asked you to run: the arm the Chat's next browser tasks plan under, for at most 60 minutes. budget-x3 gives a task three times the decision turns and active time; decision-only always plans with the decision harness; none clears the arm.
guidance: A task already running keeps the arm it started with; each task's chat-tool-planner.harness trace event names its arm. Only while the person's Chat grant is on (POLICY_DENIED CHAT_AGENT_ACCESS_NOT_GRANTED otherwise). Clear it when the benchmark ends. Requires an idempotency key.

arm.description: budget-x3, decision-only, or none to clear the arm.
The arm new tasks plan under; none when cleared.

expiresAt.description: When the arm ends by itself (ISO time); absent when cleared.
